lines.text: The Philistines gathered their forces at Aphek, and David and his men marched behind them with Achish.
Achish told the commanders he had found no fault in David, the servant of King Saul, since he defected.
The angry commanders told Achish to send David back, fearing he would become their adversary, because of the song about his tens of thousands.
Achish told David to go in peace, because the Philistine leaders did not approve, though David was as pleasing as an angel of God.
David and his men rose early to return to the land of Judah, while the Philistines went up to Jezreel.
